bound.walk: copy printed collection GET paths from the official NFR OpenAPI; skip templated paths and POST; join each path to the OpenAPI document origin because the live spec prints no servers array; do not invent path ids
bound.how: pda ingest --source nfr --limit 10. The official NFR OpenAPI prints 15 paths. 8 untemplated collection GETs are /v4/enheter, /v4/enheter/endretetter, /v4/naeringskoder, /v4/maalformer, /v4/organisasjonsformer, /v4/utgaattyper, /v4/relasjonstyper, and /v4/skolefritidsordningskategorier. Templated {organisasjonsnummer} paths and POST /v4/enheter/sok are skipped. The adapter copies the printed untemplated GET paths joined to https://data-nfr.udir.no.
